announce.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.intro: Shhh... you were never here. No one was ever here...
announce.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.phase1: More voices... more mouths... no one will remember!
announce.isekai_mahou.manticore.intro: Fresh meat walked into my den... how kind.
announce.isekai_mahou.manticore.phase1: You think the sky is safe? The sky is MINE!
announce.isekai_mahou.manticore.phase2: GRRRAAAH! I'll skewer every one of you!
announce.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.awaken: Wake up, my chests! We have guests!
announce.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.bait: Look at all this treasure! Take it, take it... hehehe.
announce.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.greed: You want gold? HAVE SOME GOLD!
announce.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.intro: Hehehe... another little thief here for MY gold?
announce.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.phase1: My treasure! MINE! Gold rains upon you!
announce.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.phase2: Since you love chests so much... GET IN!
attack.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.gold_rain: Mimic King — Gold From the Sky
boss.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.subtitle: That Which No One Remembers
boss.isekai_mahou.manticore.subtitle: Terror of the Red Rocks
boss.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.subtitle: The Treasure That Devours
command.isekai_mahou.bosses_g.spawn_fail: Could not summon the boss here.
hud.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.song: The song is erasing your memory — HIT THE BODY!
item.isekai_mahou.false_hydra_heart.desc: It still beats... and still hums softly.
item.isekai_mahou.false_hydra_heart.use: Use: 45 s invisible and swift; monsters within 32 blocks forget you.
item.isekai_mahou.false_hydra_heart.used: The song echoes... %s creatures forgot you.
item.isekai_mahou.greedy_coin.desc: It has tiny teeth. Sometimes it bites back.
item.isekai_mahou.greedy_coin.use: Use: 10 min of Luck II and Hero of the Village.
item.isekai_mahou.greedy_coin.used: The coin spins in the air... fortune smiles at you!
item.isekai_mahou.manticore_stinger.desc: Every hit poisons (Poison II) and causes bleeding.
message.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.buried: The body is buried: blows barely scratch it. Keep hitting to force it out!
message.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.exposed: The body has surfaced! Now is the time to strike!
message.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.heads: The heads vanish when you look straight at them — watch from the corner of your eye!
message.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.severed: Head severed! The body bleeds — but it will grow back.
message.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.song: It is singing! Hurt the BODY (or counter it) before the song ends!
message.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.wipe_hi: (the song wiped your memory for a moment)
message.isekai_mahou.manticore.frightene: You are Terrified! Your hits on the Manticore deal half damage.
message.isekai_mahou.manticore.tired: The Manticore is exhausted on the ground — go all out!
message.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.bait: Fake Treasure! Anything smoking or blinking a red eye is bait — don't pick it up.
message.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.bait_bit: It was fake! The treasure bit you.
message.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.devour: Someone was devoured! Hit the King (7% of its health) to make it spit them out!
message.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.inside: You were devoured! Hit from inside — it's soft in there!
message.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.maw: It's pulling you in! Hide behind a pillar or run away from the maw!
announce.isekai_mahou.manticore.last_sta: GRRR... a wounded beast bites harder!
announce.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.taunt: Hehehe... one more for the vault!
announce.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.last_st: My gold... NO ONE takes my gold!
announce.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.taunt: Shhh... no one will remember you.
announce.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.last_s: My song... falters... DO NOT FORGET ME!
